name: SCALAR-NeRF
definition: A coarse-to-fine framework for scalable large-scale neural scene reconstruction that structures the neural representation as an encoder-decoder architecture to avoid the 'foggy' issue in Block-NeRF and enable training on a single GPU.
summary: SCALAR-NeRF is a scalable neural scene reconstruction framework that avoids the foggy artifacts of Block-NeRF by fusing local block outputs with a coarse global model reference.
